English.Char_Desc_45: Zero Ads. Zero Cookie Pop-Ups. Clean Web.
English.Char_Desc_80: Block YouTube & banner ads, auto-reject cookie pop-ups, and spot fake shops.
English.Char_Desc_250: SWEEPR Deepblock is an all-in-one browser extension for Chrome, Edge, Firefox, Brave, and Safari that blocks YouTube & banner ads, automatically clicks Reject All on cookie pop-ups in under 50ms, hides junk search results, and detects fake shops.
English.Char_Desc_450: SWEEPR Deepblock stops video ads on YouTube and Twitch, automatically says No to annoying cookie consent pop-ups on 150+ frameworks without breaking page scrolling, hides copy-paste junk search results on Google and Bing, strips clutter from news and recipe pages, and warns shoppers before they buy from fake scam websites. Includes an optional Total Tab & RAM Tamer module that puts inactive tabs to sleep to free up to 62% of browser memory.
English.Char_Desc_2000:
SWEEPR Deepblock (https://sweeprdeepblock.com) is a next-generation Manifest V3 ad and pop-up blocker built for Chrome, Microsoft Edge, Brave, Opera, Mozilla Firefox, and Apple Safari.
Key Features: 1. Video & Banner Ad Shield: Blocks pre-roll and mid-roll video ads on YouTube, Twitch, and streaming sites while passing all 8 anti-adblock detection checks (verified live at https://sweeprdeepblock.com/test-lab). 2. Automatic Cookie Pop-Up Closer: Automatically clicks "Reject All" or "Necessary Only" on 150+ GDPR cookie banner frameworks in under 50 milliseconds while keeping page scrolling unlocked. 3. Clean Search Results: Hides low-quality junk and copy-paste content farms from Google, Bing, and DuckDuckGo search results. 4. 1-Click Clean Reading View: Strips away life-story intros, newsletter pop-ups, and floating video boxes on recipe and news sites. 5. Fake Online Shop & Review Detector (Included Free): Warns shoppers about suspicious online stores, fake urgency timers, and newly registered scam domains before checkout. 6. Private, Tracker-Free Browsing (Included Free): Strips hidden tracking codes (utm_, fbclid, gclid) from URLs. 7. Total Tab & RAM Tamer Add-On: Hibernates inactive background tabs to reclaim up to 62% of browser memory and saves open tab sessions against browser crashes.
